dispatched.title: Downstream consumer assumes synchronous commit
dispatched.description: order.save() is followed immediately by billing.sync(order.id), but the consumer in billing/sync.py reads the order row before the write transaction commits.
dispatched.suggestion: Await the commit, or pass the in-memory order object directly instead of re-reading it.
